 EXO-KASE Announces 2027 ‘SILENT CITY’ Fan Concert Tour Across Eight Asian Cities
 By

 EXO ’s newest unit, EXO-KASE, featuring members Kai and Sehun, is preparing to meet fans across Asia with its first-ever fan concert tour.
 On November 13, the duo officially announced the dates and cities for their upcoming ‘EXO-KASE Fancon Tour – SILENT CITY’, which will begin in January 2027 and continue through March.
 The announcement marks another exciting milestone for the newly formed unit, which is gearing up for its official musical debut.
 The tour will take Kai and Sehun to eight locations across Asia, giving fans an opportunity to experience their chemistry and performances together on stage.
 The concerts will begin in Seoul, South Korea, before moving through Southeast Asia and other major Asian destinations.
 The schedule includes Kuala Lumpur, Macau, Jakarta, Tokyo, Bangkok, Taipei, and Manila. With multiple performances planned in several cities, the tour is expected to be an important opportunity for EXO-KASE to establish its identity as a new unit.
 EXO-KASE Reveals Complete ‘SILENT CITY’ Tour Schedule
 The first two concerts will take place on January 9 and 10, 2027, at Korea University Hwajeong Tiger Dome in Seoul.
 Following the opening shows, Kai and Sehun will travel to Kuala Lumpur for a performance at IDEA LIVE ARENA on January 16.
 The duo will then visit Macau, where they are scheduled to perform at Studio City Event Center on January 23 and 24.
 Their next stop will be Jakarta on January 30, with a concert at Beach City International Stadium.
 In February, EXO-KASE will continue the tour with two performances at Tokyo Garden Theater on February 4 and 5.
 They will subsequently travel to Bangkok for concerts at Thunder Dome on February 13 and 14.
 The Asian tour will then move to Taipei, where the duo will perform at Nangang Event & Entertainment Center on February 20.
 The final announced stop will be Manila, Philippines, with a concert scheduled for March 21 at Araneta Coliseum.

 The complete tour schedule is as follows:
 – January 9–10: Seoul, South Korea – Korea University Hwajeong Tiger Dome
– January 16: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia – IDEA LIVE ARENA
– January 23–24: Macau – Studio City Event Center
– January 30: Jakarta, Indonesia – Beach City International Stadium
– February 4–5: Tokyo, Japan – Tokyo Garden Theater
– February 13–14: Bangkok, Thailand – Thunder Dome
– February 20: Taipei, Taiwan – Nangang Event & Entertainment Center
– March 21: Manila, Philippines – Araneta Coliseum
 Ticketing information for the Seoul concerts has also been announced. EXO-L members will be able to access the domestic fan club presale on November 23, followed by the global fan club presale on November 24.
 General ticket sales will begin on November 25 through Melon Ticket.
 Details for the remaining cities will be announced by their respective local promoters and ticketing platforms.

 The ‘SILENT CITY’ tour will follow EXO-KASE’s highly anticipated debut with its first mini album, ‘Waking Up The City’, scheduled for release on December 1, 2026, at 6 p.m. KST.
 The formation of EXO-KASE was officially confirmed by SM Entertainment earlier in November.
 The unit brings together Kai and Sehun, two EXO members who have already demonstrated their close friendship and performance chemistry through group activities and individual appearances.
 The two idols have previously shared stages and appeared together in EXO-related content, making their official unit debut particularly exciting for fans.
 Their collaboration also gives them an opportunity to explore a different musical direction while showcasing their individual strengths.
 With the debut album arriving in December and the first fan concert tour beginning just over a month later, EXO-KASE is preparing for a busy start to 2027.
 The eight-city schedule will allow Kai and Sehun to connect with international fans through live performances and fan-focused activities.
 As anticipation builds for ‘Waking Up The City’, EXO-Ls are looking forward to seeing what the duo has prepared for both their debut and their first-ever fan concert tour.
 ‘SILENT CITY’ will mark the beginning of a new chapter for Kai and Sehun as EXO-KASE.
